prompt:
Revise this SanForum.at mobile forum concept while preserving its portrait 390:844 proportions, deep-blue header, existing SanForum logo, white reading surface, blue accent, and familiar Discourse controls. Use the second reference as the exact original logo; retain its original proportions.

Make the course-program rhythm genuinely compact and precise. Replace the three oversized rounded category cards and colourful icon tiles with three clean, compact category rows, separated by subtle rules. Retain the exact German category titles, a small category marker and a right-aligned activity count. Category browsing and recent discussions must remain equally easy to find, but the category index should occupy about one quarter of the screen rather than half.

Make the recent discussion rows the signature: title and category context to the left, consistent reply count and relative time in one aligned activity column on the right. Remove invented post excerpts and first-person claims. Keep “Nützliche Apps für den Dienst”, “NFS-Kurs Empfehlung”, and “Monitoring im Vergleich”, with a clear blue unread indicator plus the word “Ungelesen”. Retain the conventional “Neues Thema” action.

Add a clearly readable small label “Beispielansicht · Beispieldaten” below the main navigation so every sample count is honestly identified. No large decorative tiles, no cards around every row, no marketing content.
generationPrompt:
Create a high-fidelity mobile Discourse forum overview for SanForum.at, rendered edge to edge at portrait 390:844 proportions with crisp, readable German text. This is the working forum itself, without a physical phone, browser frame or desk. Austria’s rescue-service community comes here to browse categories and catch up on conversations; those two jobs have equal prominence.

Use the attached logo as an unchanged brand asset, preserving its proportions and details, on a contrasting deep-blue header. The header contains familiar menu, search and account controls. The body is light, with white reading surfaces, cool blue neutrals and the existing #3877E5 accent. Use one disciplined, highly readable sans-serif family.

The direction is a compact course-program rhythm translated into a forum: the signature is a perfectly aligned activity column running through the topic rows, never a literal timetable or calendar. In reading order show equal access to “Kategorien” and “Aktuell”; a short category index with “Rettungsdienst & Krankentransport”, “Aus-, Fort- und Weiterbildung”, and “Geräte, Fahrzeuge & Technik”; then recent discussions with the titles “Nützliche Apps für den Dienst”, “NFS-Kurs Empfehlung”, and “Monitoring im Vergleich”. Include a clearly marked unread topic, useful category context, and aligned sample reply counts and relative times. A small “Beispielansicht” label identifies demonstration metadata. Keep generous touch targets despite the compact rhythm.

Include a conventional “Neues Thema” button and the start of the continuing topic list at the lower edge. The screen must be immediately recognizable as a polished, usable forum. No marketing hero, decorative charts, private usernames or profile photographs.
